description: This is a server entry point file for a Remix-based web application. It handles server-side rendering requests, differentiating between bot and browser requests, and streams React components to the client.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Handles incoming HTTP requests, routing to bot or browser specific rendering functions based on user-agent.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Streams server-side rendered React components optimized for bots.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Streams server-side rendered React components optimized for browsers.
